sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Only the structural clauses are promoted: Triebklassen are derived from the strongest Tendenzspannungsdifferenzen, while all four Spannungsdifferenzen retain a specific role. The neighboring future-oriented Schicksalsdiagnose language is explicitly excluded from execution.
U003879 defines Gefahr-/Wurzelklassen by Latenzgrößen über 4; U003880 explicitly allows one, two, three or all four Latenzgrößen to exceed 4 and classifies them as one through four dangers.

sourceExcerpt: Eben deshalb ermittelten wir die Triebklassen aus den größten Tendenzspannungsdifferenzen; also aus den stärksten Latenzgraden und nicht aus den kleinsten. Wir betonen aber nochmals, daß bei der Diagnose alle vier Spannungsdifferenzen eine wichtige, spezielle Rolle spielen müssen. In einer Reihe der Latenzproportionen kann in einem Fall nur eine Latenzgröße, in anderen Fällen können zwei oder drei, ja sogar alle vier Latenzgrößen über 4 stehen. ... Eine Gefahr, zwei, drei und vier Gefahren.
romanianRendering: Triebklassen sunt stabilite din cele mai mari Tendenzspannungsdifferenzen, adică din cele mai puternice Latenzgrade, dar toate cele patru Spannungsdifferenzen trebuie păstrate cu rolul lor specific. Într-o serie a Latenzproportionen, una, două, trei sau chiar toate patru Latenzgrößen pot fi peste 4; Szondi clasifică astfel clasele cu unul, două, trei sau patru pericole.
doctrinalStatement: Haupttriebklasse/Triebklasse derivată din maxim nu epuizează structura Latenzproportionen. Szondi cere păstrarea tuturor celor patru Spannungsdifferenzen și recunoaște explicit Gefahrklassen cu una până la patru Triebgefahren simultane. Prin urmare, atunci când mai multe Latenzgrößen sunt peste pragul de Gefahr, pluralitatea lor este o proprietate structurală legitimă a seriei și nu trebuie redusă la singurul maxim.
conditions: Applies when Latenzproportionen/Gefahr-Ventil status has been validly computed from at least three foreground profiles on the source-authorized ten-series basis or via Tabelle 13 conversion.
scopeNotes: The count of one to four Triebgefahren is structural and does not by itself measure severity, illness, dangerousness, decompensation or prognosis.
The instruction that all four Spannungsdifferenzen retain a role does not imply equal clinical weight; the maximum remains relevant for Triebklasse/Haupttriebklasse under its separate rules.
Do not execute the neighboring future-oriented Schicksalsdiagnose/prophylaxis language from U003846 as a prediction of future illness, behavior or destiny.
Do not infer the psychological content of a danger vector merely from its status; factor/vector content requires separate source-grounded doctrines.
reviewNotes: Canonical anchors U003846 and U003877-U003880 verified against the preserved P0 canonical-access artifact for SZ_LEHR_1972.
Executable use is restricted to preserving simultaneous structural danger zones; no future prediction or diagnostic severity rule is imported.
